desc:
🛴 ProRiders - the electric scooter life in Kirin Bay

Ride real-inspired e-scooters through a living open city: beach, downtown, hills and a motorway with speed cameras.

⚡ What you can do
• Tune your scooter with real parts: motors, batteries, tyres, brakes, VESC settings (push too far and you can burn the motor!)
• Race the city routes, pull wheelies, dodge the police
• Earn money riding, delivering food, and from jobs
• Use your in-game phone: store, garage, maps, bank, messages, contacts
• Build your garage, customise colours, LEDs and stickers
• Play with up to 15 players per server

🚧 BETA VERSION
